children: Cables and wires stocks Polycab Ltd., RR Kabel Ltd., and Finolex Cables Ltd. have declined between 6% to 10% this week, as copper prices fell to their five-month low.
LME copper has corrected 11% from its recent peak of $14,870/MT. At the current spot, copper is 4% below its averages of the second quarter of this fiscal.
As per media reports, wires and cables players have started taking price cuts between 5% to 6% over the past eight to 10 days.
High base from channel upstocking
Volume growth of cables and wires players is likely to soften on a high base, according to analysts.
Copper prices rose 21% sequentially in the third quarter last year (11% in December 2025 alone), resulting in aggressive upstocking of channel inventory, ahead of successive price hikes.

In the third quarter of the previous fiscal, wires and cables companies had reported stellar volume growth. Polycab's volumes grew 40%, RR Kabel's domestic volume growth was 30%, while volume growth in Finolex's wires business was 28% during the same quarter last year for the October-December period.
Destocking can weigh on volumes
With copper trending down, dealers are likely to defer purchases in anticipation of further cuts.
Equirus expects channel inventory filling to moderate in the third quarter of financial year 2027, impacting volume growth across the wire and cable players on a high base.
Realisations and margins
Equirus said margins should largely hold as price changes are passed through. The absolute profit per unit might see some downside risks, it added.
Stock reaction
Shares of
Polycab India
were trading 5% lower at ₹7,314.5 apiece. The stock has declined 8.9% in the past month, 19.7% in the last six months and as a result, has turned negative on a year-to-date basis.
RR Kabel
shares were trading 1.9% lower at ₹1,823 apiece. The stock has declined 23.6% in the past month, 6.3% in the last six months and 24.2% this year, so far.
Finolex Cables
shares were trading 3.3% lower at ₹1,189.7 apiece. The stock has fallen 7.3% in the past month, but is up 16.2% in the last six months and up 51.2% this year, so far.

title: Copper prices at five-month low - Here's how Polycab, Finolex, RR Kabel shares reacted
